text: Level three, question six: a car covers two hundred and forty kilometres; if its speed were twenty kilometres per hour more, it would take one hour less; find its speed. Question seven: had a man walked three kilometres per hour faster, he would have taken forty minutes less; had he walked two kilometres per hour slower, he would have taken forty minutes more; find the distance. Question eight: a train covers the first third of its journey at its usual speed, and the rest at three-quarters of its usual speed; it arrives forty minutes late; find its usual journey time.
